Summary: Set up Jira project: epics, components, 2-week sprints
Description: Create epics: ML, Backend, Auth, Cameras, Alerts, Frontend, DevOps & QA, Docs & PM. Import this backlog.

Summary: Interview 2-3 store owners/staff and get permission to film staged clips
Description: Collect requirements (who gets alerts, which cameras, checkout/exit layout). Get written permission to record staged theft clips on their Hikvision cameras.

Summary: Write SRS v1 with prioritized requirements (MoSCoW)
Description: Functional + non-functional requirements, use cases, risks. Based on the proposal scope.

Summary: Create GitHub repo structure, branch protection and PR template
Description: Folders: ml/, backend/, frontend/, edge-agent/, docs/. Protect main, require 1 review. Add PR and issue templates.

Summary: Connect Jira with GitHub
Description: Install GitHub for Jira. Convention: branch and commit names include the Jira key (e.g. LUMI-12).

Summary: Kaggle notebook setup and baseline test of a pretrained UCF-Crime VideoMAE
Description: GPU T4/P100, Internet on, attach DCSASS. Run the public UCF-Crime VideoMAE checkpoint on a few shoplifting/normal clips and record a baseline score.

Summary: Prepare DCSASS data: filter Shoplifting/Normal, split by source video, write manifest CSV
Description: Read the label CSVs, build manifest (path,label,source_video,split). Split 70/15/15 BY SOURCE VIDEO to avoid leakage. Report class counts.

Summary: Design system architecture and choose tech stack
Description: Diagram: edge agent -> backend API -> Postgres/file storage -> frontend + Telegram/email. Proposed stack: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React.

Summary: Design PostgreSQL schema: users, stores, cameras, zones, events
Description: ER diagram + migrations. events: id, camera_id, started_at, score, status(pending/confirmed/dismissed), clip_path, snapshot_path.

Summary: Wireframes: login, register, dashboard, cameras, event review
Description: Low-fi wireframes in Figma, reviewed with Temur against SRS.

Summary: Fine-tune VideoMAE-base on Shoplifting vs Normal (Kaggle)
Description: Start from MCG-NJU/videomae-base-finetuned-kinetics, 2 classes, 16 frames 224px, fp16, class weights, augmentations. Save best checkpoint to Kaggle output / HF Hub (private).

Summary: Evaluation notebook: precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, confusion matrix, threshold choice
Description: Evaluate on held-out test split and on unseen data (own clips / MNNIT). Pick the alert threshold; report false alarms per hour on normal footage.

Summary: Record and label own staged clips from a real store
Description: 50-100 clips from the store's cameras (sub-stream). Mix of normal shopping and concealment. Label in a CSV with same format as the manifest. Whole team helps act.

Summary: Backend scaffold: FastAPI + Postgres in docker-compose
Description: Health endpoint, config via .env, Alembic migrations, runs with `docker compose up`.

Summary: Auth API: register, login (JWT), password hashing, current user
Description: POST /auth/register, POST /auth/login, GET /auth/me. bcrypt/argon2, JWT access token. Roles: owner, staff.

Summary: Frontend scaffold: React + Vite, routing, API client
Description: Shared layout, env-based API URL, lint setup.

Summary: Register and Login pages with protected routes
Description: Form validation, error messages, store token, redirect unauthenticated users to login.

Summary: CI with GitHub Actions: lint and tests for backend and frontend
Description: Run on every PR; block merge if failing.

Summary: Person detection and tracking (YOLO + ByteTrack) with per-person clip cropping
Description: Pretrained YOLO person class, ByteTrack IDs, crop 16-frame clip around each tracked person, skip frames with no people.

Summary: Checkout/exit zone rule: flag concealment, alert if person exits without passing checkout
Description: Zones are polygons per camera from DB. Rule combines model score over threshold + zone path of track ID.

Summary: Inference pipeline: video file or RTSP in, events out, reduced frame rate
Description: Process ~5 fps from sub-stream; outputs event JSON with timestamp, camera, score, 10s clip + snapshot.

Summary: Cameras API: add/edit/delete camera, Hikvision RTSP URL builder, encrypted credentials
Description: Input: IP, port (554), channel, stream (main 01/sub 02), username, password -> rtsp://user:pass@ip:554/Streaming/Channels/<ch><stream>. Store password encrypted.

Summary: Edge agent prototype: read Hikvision RTSP, run inference, send events to backend
Description: Python + OpenCV/FFmpeg on a store PC. Reconnect on drop. Uploads clip and snapshot, POST /events with an API key per store.

Summary: Add-camera form with 'Test connection' and zone drawing on a snapshot
Description: User enters camera details, sees live snapshot, draws checkout and exit polygons.

Summary: Dashboard: stores and cameras list with online/offline status
Description: Cards per camera with last frame time and today's alert count.

Summary: Events API: list, detail, confirm/dismiss; clip and snapshot storage
Description: GET /events with filters, PATCH /events/{id} status, serve media files with auth.

Summary: Telegram alert bot
Description: Bot sends snapshot + time + camera name + link to review page. Manager links their chat via /start code.

Summary: Email alerts
Description: SMTP, same content as Telegram. Rate-limit duplicates for same track.

Summary: Live alerts view (WebSocket or polling)
Description: New alert pops up with sound and snapshot within seconds.

Summary: Event review screen: clip player, confirm or dismiss
Description: Shows timestamp, camera, score, video clip. Buttons Confirm / Dismiss (false alarm).

Summary: Test plan and end-to-end test on recorded store video
Description: Feed recorded video through edge agent -> alert arrives -> review works. Measure alert latency.

Summary: Deploy backend + frontend (Docker) to a server
Description: One VPS, HTTPS, environment secrets, backups for Postgres.

Summary: User guide: how to find and connect your Hikvision camera
Description: Find IP via SADP tool, enable RTSP, create a viewer user, sub-stream settings.

Summary: Privacy notice and data retention policy
Description: No face recognition, store only flagged clips, retention period, customer notice sign. Uzbekistan personal data law.

Summary: Midterm presentation (20 min) and demo script
Description: Problem, solution, architecture, model results, live demo on recorded video, risks.

Summary: Alert statistics page: events per day/camera, false-alarm rate
Description: Should-have.

Summary: Adjustable detection sensitivity per camera
Description: Should-have. Threshold stored per camera, used by edge agent.

Summary: Multiple stores per account and staff invitations
Description: Should-have.
